segments.name: Tronox
segments.description: Vertically integrated miner and producer of titanium dioxide pigment, zircon, pig iron, monazite and titanium chemicals sold to industrial customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate our business under one operating segment, Tronox, which is also our reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Industrial customers worldwide pay for titanium dioxide pigment, mineral sands co-products such as zircon and pig iron, and titanium chemicals.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe that vertical integration is the best way to achieve our ultimate goal of delivering low cost, high-quality pigment to our approximately 1,200 TiO 2 customers throughout the world.

changes.text: In 2025 the company shut down the Botlek pigment plant in the Netherlands and idled the Fuzhou pigment plant in China.
changes.evidence: At the same time, throughout 2025, we implemented targeted operational measures to manage near-term cash flow, including: shutting down the Botlek pigment plant in the Netherlands, idling the Fuzhou pigment plant in China, and temporarily idling one furnace at the Namakwa smelter.
